codex cannot self-enforce version; halod enforces
codex: Windows has no system-wide managed_config.toml (only ~/.codex); model, gateway, telemetry and MCP server definitions (with their tool lists) are not rendered, only requirements.toml
codex: no gateway configured; traffic is not routed through Halos
codex: egress default deny renders network_access = false, so sandboxed commands reach the allowlisted hosts only after the user sets network_access = true; [experimental_network] in requirements.toml then limits them
codex: sandbox.protectedPaths are rendered as deny_read (reads); Codex has no managed deny-write list, so writes are held only by the sandbox mode
codex: on native Windows deny_read applies to direct file tools only, not shell subprocess reads
codex: egress is rendered as requirements.toml [experimental_network], which OpenAI documents as experimental; the minimum codex version honoring it is not documented (UNVERIFIED), and it does not filter web search, MCP servers or Codex's own service requests
